notes:
{土地|とち} means land or property—a piece of ground, especially for ownership or a geographical area.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{土地勘|とちかん}→土地勘：19461_tochikan⟧: familiarity with an area
- ⟦{土地柄|とちがら}→土地柄：12138_tochigara⟧: local characteristics, regional nature
- ⟦{土地代|とちだい}→土地代：28478_tochidai⟧: land price, property cost
- ⟦{借地|しゃくち}→借地：17019_shakuchi⟧: leased land
- ⟦{宅地|たくち}→宅地：21589_takuchi⟧: residential land

- {土地|とち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy land
- {土地|とち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell land
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{土地|とち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: local people

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {土地|とち} prices vary dramatically by location. Urban areas like Tokyo have extremely high land values compared to rural regions.
